title: The Sigil of the Sundered Sea
author: Vesper Pemberton
blurb: Felix Marchetti, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
